title: Handley Page Hampden AD783
memorial_details: description: Stone obelisk sitting on a base surrounded by a chain link fence supported by wooden posts. The front face has an incised inscription picked out in black, and the badges of RAF Bomber Command and 455 Sqn RAAF in colour at the top. On the building wall opposite to the front face of the obelisk is a glazed and framed information board with the history of the aircraft crash and the dedication of the memorial.
